result.topic_en: Riemann discusses the zeros of the theta function $\vartheta(u_1-e_1,\dots,u_p-e_p)$ on a Riemann surface: the constants $e$ are expressed through the zero points $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_p$ and constants $k_\nu$ given by integrals, and he considers the case where the theta function vanishes identically.
